chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥuḍaynī wrote to him:
My cousin instructed in his will that hajj be performed on his behalf with fifteen dinars in every year, but it is not sufficient, so what do you command me concerning that?
So he, peace be upon him, wrote: “You should combine two hajj pilgrimages into one hajj, if Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of that.”

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he made a bequest in his will
key_terms.تَجْعَلُ حَجَّتَيْنِ فِي حَجَّةٍ: combine two intended hajj allocations into one performed hajj
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ دِينَارًا: fifteen dinars, the specified amount of money
key_terms.يُحَجَّ: that hajj be performed on someone's behalf

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a deceased person bequeathed too little money for annual hajj on their behalf?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question about a bequest for hajj when the specified amount is no longer sufficient to fulfill it annually. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that two years' allocations be combined into one hajj, affirming a practical juristic solution while entrusting the matter to Allah’s knowledge.
